100ms — realtime video

100ms/realtime · version 1

envs add 100ms/realtime

This declares the keys below in your catalog and sets none of them. A template is a schema for keys; it never carries a value.

Key Needed Kind Notes
APP_ACCESS_KEY required secret Half of the signing pair. The names come from 100ms's own sample backend and are unusually generic for a shared file, so expect to rename them if another service claims the same.. where to get it
APP_SECRET required secret 100ms says this ensures the workspace secret is not exposed to the client side, and that the management token must not be exposed there either. The browser receives a generated auth token, or a narrower room code.. where to get it
